module.purpose: Provides the scheduling service that resolves event types, hosts, calendars, booking constraints, reservations, and timezone rules into bookable slot responses for the viewer slots router.
module.summary: This file implements the availability calculation pipeline for regular, team, round-robin, collective, and dynamic bookings. It retrieves event types and users through repositories, evaluates calendar busy times, out-of-office dates, booking and duration limits, team limits, reserved seats, restriction schedules, routing forms, fallback hosts, and rolling-window boundaries. The service aggregates host availability, filters conflicts and invalid times, groups slots by localized date, and optionally produces troubleshooting data or no-slot notifications.
module.businessContext: This supports appointment scheduling by showing customers accurate, bookable times across hosts, teams, calendars, and routing rules. Failures can expose unavailable times, violate booking limits, overbook seats, or prevent customers from booking.

preconditions: eventType must be non-null (type excludes null)
hosts array must contain objects with a user property of type GetAvailabilityUserWithDelegationCredentials
startTime and endTime must define a valid, non-inverted time range
startTime must be a Dayjs-compatible value returned by getStartTime
endTime must be a valid Dayjs instance
postconditions: Returns an object with keys: allUsersAvailability, usersWithCredentials, and currentSeats
allUsersAvailability has the same length as the number of users with credentials, each entry containing timeZone, dateRanges, oooExcludedDateRanges, busy, user, and datesOutOfOffice
currentSeats is undefined if no user has truthy currentSeats in their availability data
invariants: allUsersAvailability array length equals usersWithCredentials array length
currentSeats is set from the first user whose availability contains truthy currentSeats and is not overwritten by subsequent users
The time window for booking and OOO date queries is expanded by input.duration minutes on both ends when input.rescheduleUid is truthy and duration is non-zero
edgeCases: When input.rescheduleUid is falsy or input.duration is 0: startTimeDate = startTime.toDate(), endTimeDate = endTime.toDate() (no expansion)
When input.rescheduleUid is truthy and input.duration is non-zero: startTimeDate = startTime.subtract(duration, 'minute').toDate(), endTimeDate = endTime.add(duration, 'minute').toDate()
When eventType has no bookingLimits or durationLimits: busyTimesFromLimitsBookingsAllUsers remains [] and busyTimesFromLimitsMap remains undefined
When eventType has no team or team has no bookingLimits: teamBookingLimitsMap remains undefined
When no user has truthy currentSeats in availability data: currentSeats remains undefined
When usersWithCredentials is empty: allUserIds is empty and allUsersAvailability is empty

detail.name: _getAvailableSlots
preconditions: input must conform to GetScheduleOptions, providing startTime, endTime, timeZone, and event-identifying fields (usernameList/eventTypeSlug/orgSlug).
The event type resolvable via getRegularOrDynamicEventType must exist, otherwise a NOT_FOUND error is raised.
startTime and endTime must parse to valid dayjs instants; otherwise a BAD_REQUEST is raised.
When a restriction schedule is active, the resolved restriction schedule must provide a timeZone unless eventType.useBookerTimezone is true, otherwise a BAD_REQUEST is raised.
postconditions: Returns IGetAvailableSlots shaped as { slots: Record<YYYY-MM-DD, Array<{ time: string, attendees?: number, bookingUid?: string }>>, troubleshooter?: {...} | null }.
Returned slot times respect minimum booking notice, period limits, restriction-schedule availability, and reserved (already-booked) slot exclusion.
Expired reserved slots are purged from storage as a side effect via _getReservedSlotsAndCleanupExpired.
invariants: Output date keys are formatted as YYYY-MM-DD in the booker's input.timeZone using the fr-CA locale.
For ROLLING_WINDOW event types, a future startTime is shifted back 1 month before availability computation.
Fallback-RR fairness is evaluated only over a 2-week lookahead window from 'now'.
Each returned slot time is an ISO-8601 UTC string.
edgeCases: StartTime already in the past is not shifted (rolling-window adjustment skipped).
hasFallbackRRHosts with startTime before twoWeeksFromNow rebases the fairness-check startTime to 'now'.
Restriction-schedule feature disabled OR no restrictionSchedule found leaves availableTimeSlots equal to timeSlots (no extra filtering).
Restriction schedule enabled, useBookerTimezone false, and restrictionSchedule.timeZone absent raises BAD_REQUEST 'No timezone is set for the restricted schedule'.
No reserved slots leaves the slot list unaffected by seat merging.
Reserved slots present but none marked as seats skips the seat-merge branch.

Empty withinBoundsSlotsMappedToDate combined with a single usernameList triggers best-effort handleNotificationWhenNoSlots; its failures are caught, logged, and swallowed so availability still returns.
_enableTroubleshooter true includes the troubleshooter diagnostics object; otherwise it is null/absent.
eventType.onlyShowFirstAvailableSlot truthy collapses each date key to at most one slot.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: TRPCError codes surfaced: NOT_FOUND when the event type cannot be resolved; BAD_REQUEST with message 'Invalid time range given.' when startTime/endTime are invalid; BAD_REQUEST with message 'No timezone is set for the restricted schedule' when a restriction schedule lacks a timezone. handleNotificationWhenNoSlots failures are caught, logged, and swallowed (not propagated).
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: No fallback value is returned for configuration/data errors: all such errors propagate as TRPCError. Only handleNotificationWhenNoSlots errors are swallowed so availability still returns.

stateMutations: Invokes _getReservedSlotsAndCleanupExpired, which purges expired reserved-slot entries from backing storage for the resolved eventTypeId/users.
Does not directly mutate instance fields or the passed input/caller context.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an object with `slots`: an object keyed by YYYY-MM-DD date strings (formatted in input.timeZone via the fr-CA locale) mapping to arrays of { time: ISO-8601 UTC string, attendees?: number, bookingUid?: string }, plus an optional `troubleshooter` object ({ routedTeamMemberIds, askedContactOwner, consideredContactOwner, routedHosts: [{ userId }], hostsAfterSegmentMatching: [{ userId }] }) present only when input._enableTroubleshooter is true (null otherwise).
detail.summary: Computes and returns bookable time slots for an event type within the requested time range, applying host qualification, rolling-window and fallback-round-robin fairness, restriction schedules, reserved-seat cleanup, and period-limit/booking-notice filtering, and optionally emits troubleshooter diagnostics.
